items.title: 67426_Hayes Pillars oral history interview
items.q: We took Big Sidney on our tour to Little Rock, Arkansas... Big Sidney worked that whole summer with us

ctx.x: And hold the tempo there, he was a stonewall. He was a great artist. We took Big Sidney on our tour to Little Rock, Arkansas. This was the first time that we had a chance to take our band back home. And we played Little Rock, we played Jackson, Tennessee, we played several towns, you know, that summer. And the people in Arkansas just

went crazy about the band. And Big Sid, his beautiful personality, everybody just loved him. He was a lovable -- a lovable type of guy. He was just a great person. Big Sidney worked that whole summer with us, did he leave before we opened --
No, he didn't leave -- he didn't leave -- he opened the season.
